title: The stretching spring
hook: Change extension and predict spring restoring-force magnitude.
misconception: spring restoring-force magnitude stays fixed when extension doubles.
objective: Apply F = kx to compare spring restoring-force magnitude when extension changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With an ideal spring with fixed stiffness, F = kx. When extension doubles, spring restoring-force magnitude becomes 2 times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model F = kx; scaling exponent 1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider an ideal spring with fixed stiffness, with a nonzero initial result. If extension triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on spring restoring-force magnitude?
recall.why: Apply F = kx under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 3.
